title: Can I MASTER Roblox Chess?
summary: The creator plays a (different from last time) Roblox chess game: avatars walk around a lobby and sit at 3D tables with chess boards to challenge other Roblox players. There is no rating system. Goal: win five games. He wins games 1-5 against random players (fool's-mate attempts, early queen sorties, 'base camp' setups), then plays a sixth game with a self-imposed drawback (never moving his queen) and wins that too. Ends standing on another avatar's head.
rules: Normal chess rules, standard start, no rating system.
Sit at a free table seat to choose colour; both players press ready to start.
Once a game starts you cannot get up from the table.
Bonus game 6: self-imposed rule 'I won't move my queen for the whole game'.
win_condition: Checkmate each Roblox opponent; series goal 5 wins (got 6).

opponent.name: Random Roblox players (no names/ratings shown)
opponent.avatar_description: Blocky Roblox-style avatar seated across the table. Remake: original blocky low-poly character (square head, rectangular torso), random shirt colour.

board.shape_notes: standard 8x8; shown both as a 3D tabletop board and a 2D picture-in-picture board
board.theme_notes: 2D overlay uses green/cream; the in-game 3D board is brown/white on a table in a Roblox lobby.

events: Lobby: pick a table/seat; opponent may join or leave.
Optional bonus challenge: queen may not move.
visual_fx: 3D table and avatars around the board; close-up board view toggle (8:57 'keep this close-up view').
Avatar can jump/stand on other avatars' heads after games (flavour).
current_impl_issues: Legacy implements a bot 'gauntlet' ladder (Noob..Admin); video is plain chess vs unrated Roblox players in a 3D lobby, win 5. Should be normal chess vs weak/random-ish human-like bots with Roblox-style blocky presentation; optional 'no queen moves' bonus round.
